omar (Solutions Eng): Quick snippet for one-pager pricing example:
```
Included: 150k tokens/mo
Requested overage cap: $4,000/mo (tokens only)
```
lina (CS): I'll push the questionnaire answers and confirm rotation cadence with customer this morning.
meet-bot: Calendar: "HelioPay Exec Briefing" Thu 14:00 CET - tentative invites sent
